title: The book can wait
lines: A book can wait for you without changing its story to win you back.
The Book Sends No Notifications explores what that quiet relationship offers amid faster answers and constant invitations.
At its opening, someone reads a novel while a conference announces the death of books.

title: A perspective that stays put
